latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of video-intro — generate branded video intros in seconds.

- Instantly create professional, branded video intros with a simple text prompt and video upload.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB; all processing happens on powerful cloud GPUs.
- Automatic environment setup with free credits on the first connection—no manual configuration needed.
- Clean workflows for uploading, editing, previewing timelines, and exporting intros.
- Includes support for credits, session state tracking, and clear error feedback.
- Ideal for YouTubers and creators wanting polished intros without complex editing tools.
